query: Mexican restaurants in Round Rock, TX

reviews_data.review_text:
Not a bad experience! The staff (Ana in particular) were so friendly and helpful. I tried the street tacos (carne asada) which were excellent and had a barbacoa taco. I loved the street tacos the best! We had a bit of a snafu with my friend’s order but it was cleared up nicely.

Pro Tip: They only serve the barbacoa taco Saturday and Sundays for brunch.

8/10 Tacos 🌮

We have visited La Margarita many times over the years and have never been disappointed. Staff is awesome and food is constantly on point and delicious. If I had to say one thing, it would be that the charro beans need more flavor. More onion and cilantro. Otherwise, we loved our meal!

Safe bet for your Tex Mex favorites. I had the lunch special chicken fajitas. The portion was nice for the price. The chicken itself was good, but needed some more spices or to be marinated. Salsa was decent. The rice and beans were pretty standard. Overall a good option for something on this side of town, but not a meal I would travel across  town for.

I rented out the party room for $25 dollars an hour for two hours  for a party of 17 which it was big enough with a patio.
The food was decent. The service was fast. The  only issue I had was as soon as we paid the bill. No one ever came to check on use for refills or if we needed anything TOGO
Management never came by once or anything it was a little different from other places that I have rened party rooms from.
The fajitas were great.  The charro beans were amazing.  And the Margaritas.

Chunky guac wad indeed chunky guac. we thought it was good.  Salsa was pretty good too! I especially enjoyed mixing the salsa guac. And lime! Thats was where it was at!

Margaritas were good too just a bit over priced for basic syrup bare minimal alcohol.

Moving on to entrees. We ordered fajitas for two steak chicken and shrimp. We got just steak! And quite a bit. So when we asked our server about the other 2 meats she brought me 2 baby bowls of VERY LITTLE CHICKEN AND SHRIMP! All the meats were super tender just not flavorful. Even the tortillas server got wrong. We asked for corn and we got flour. I will admit they were good!
Kids got chicken flautas those were super large and pretty good. Rice was good and beans were meh.
It was our first visit here and idk it just wasnt an omg! We must come back.

For us, what made our experience was a balloon  character making lady! She was amazing and talented!

reviews_data.review_text: We use to come here alot. Last few times (today for example), the food was very bland. The Verde sauce was very bad. Our fajitas had zero flavor. The charro beans tasted like hot water. The rice had very little flavor. The best part of our meal was the salsa. The tortillas were okay, normally they are usually better than what we had. They tasted kind of raw. We will not be back.

Wonderful greeting and clean, very clean tables.  Our waitress was very patient with us, and was very attentive.  The food was delicious, and it was very Mexican authentic.  I thought I was at my grandma’s having supper.  Food was that delicious.

reviews_data.owner_answer: Thanks Ryan. We appreciate your feedback and hope we can continue to provide great food and service as we grow.  Come back soon!
reviews_data.review_text:
If you want quick classic breakfast this is the place to go. There are plenty of overly fancy places with pour over coffee and non tradition tacos, but when it comes to hospitality and quality food without a giant price tag this is the place to go.

$2 coffee
$3.75 breakfast tacos
$4 street tacos

Good portions with great flavor. Friendly staff. Family owned. Plus their salsa as made in-house and the green is where it’s at 👌 highly recommend.

reviews_data.owner_answer: Thanks for enjoying our food in the food truck and now at Casita on the Main. We appreciate your family continuing your birthday celebration here. The carnitas will be ready for you next time as well since it is a daily offering now. Come back soon!

reviews_data.review_text: Absolutely loved the delicious food, awesome service and vibe! 😋 If my Abuelita made puerco en chile verde, it would be like this. My family and I are looking forward to our next visit to try different dishes. Highly recommend!

reviews_data.review_text: On the main street in Round Rock, an eatery reminiscent of my grandmother's kitchen comes into view. With familiar smells and cozy hospitality, the concise menu satisfied my appetite for unique Mexican food. Fusion is key here with traditional dishes. Wow!

reviews_data.owner_answer: Thank you so much for coming by and letting us know how we did. We appreciate your feedback and will work to do our best each and every day.

reviews_data.review_text: They're just starting out so the menu is somewhat limited. I had the sandwich (forgot what it was called). I opted for beef and it came with cheese on Texas Toast. Oh was it ever good. I'll be going back to have that again for sure. Service was very friendly.
